svg.title: Reconcile: Topographic survey print
svg.desc: Reconcile (1D): a topographic survey sheet of the campground, contour lines round the hill and the loop road with its numbered site squares; squares 1 to 6 have already gone from the print. Under it, the green-ink legend has a missing row. On the right, Tam's notebook rows set each site Here, Gone or Unknown against Ground, Map, Legend and Photos, and a pencil forecast line crosses the loop to say where the loss will reach by noon.
